method: Manual inspection of original full-window screenshots, separate from process/window assertions.

observations.observed: At 440 pixels, the horizontal inventory clips the right side of Unload content.
With the compact menu before the receiver correction, pressing its content action leaves the fatal Native dockspace stopped strip and disabled controls.
Inspector submenu contains selection, all four movement commands, pane/group close and Unload content within the narrow host.
Menu closes; Last action reports Inspector content unloaded, with key/title/data retained; no fatal status strip.
Last action reports Inspector content reloaded; editor remains live.
Named Close Inspector confirmation offers Close, Keep open and Decide later before removal.
After explicit approval, inventory marks Inspector closed and offers Reopen with the content action.
Inspector is selected in the main dockspace, editable default notes remain, and Last action reports reopened with retained content.
Complete-root native source is suppressed during drag; destination guides and ghost are visible.
After Escape, a real content click and edit, toolbar save/default/restore and another edit, the fresh child shows CANCEL_BEFORE, CANCEL_AFTER and RESTORED_EDIT markers.
After individual-tab drag cancellation and toolbar restoration, the fresh child shows CANCEL_BEFORE and RESTORED_EDIT markers.
